themes.name: High Contrast
themes.author: Grimoire
themes.description: Maximum legibility in both light and dark: pure black or pure white surfaces, full-strength text, and saturated accents. Every foreground clears WCAG AAA (7:1) against every background, and the low-contrast greys of the default theme are gone. Follows System, so it tracks your OS setting. Raises luminance contrast only — it does not address colourblindness, which needs more than a change of colour.
